title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving preventive and curative nutrition services for children under five and pregnant and lactating mothers, and WASH response

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to improve access to integrated nutrition services for children and pregnant and lactating women and to increase access to WASH services. This UNICEF project 1) screens 159,188 people for malnutrition, 2) provides over 100,000 people with micronutrients, and 3) provides 70,000 people with access to sufficient and safe water for drinking, cooking and/or personal hygiene use among other activities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 159,188 people, including 59,233 women, 23,304 men, 100,000 children, and 2,001 persons with disabilities.
